migrate.title: Move terminal to another venue
migrate.subtitle: {{name}} ({{serial}}) — currently at {{venue}}.
migrate.migrateMerchantHelp: The terminal keeps its current merchant and the destination venue is set up to charge with it.
migrate.doNotUse: Do NOT use this terminal until finished.
migrate.stepDelivered: Wipe command delivered to the terminal
migrate.stepRebound: The terminal restarted and wiped its memory
migrate.stepReboundPending: Waiting for the terminal to restart…
migrate.stepOnline: The terminal is online at the new venue
migrate.timeoutTitle: The terminal hasn't reappeared yet. Make sure it's powered on and online.
migrate.timeoutBody: The venue change is already applied on the server. When the terminal connects it will pull the wipe and show up on its own at the new venue — you don't need to repeat the migration.
migrate.completeToastBody: The terminal is active at the new venue.
migrate.confirmBody: {{name}} will be re-assigned to {{venue}} and a FACTORY RESET will be sent. The terminal will restart, wipe its memory and show up on its own at the new venue. This action cannot be undone.
migrate.cancelConfirmBody: The terminal will return to its original venue. This only works if the terminal hasn't wiped yet.
migrate.cancelledToastBody: The terminal returned to its original venue.

pendingWipe.title: Factory reset pending since {{date}}
pendingWipe.originMigration: Left by a migration to {{venue}}. The terminal has not executed it yet.
pendingWipe.originManual: Left by a manual factory reset. The terminal has not executed it yet.
pendingWipe.cancellableHelp: The terminal has not received it yet: you can cancel it and go on with this migration.
pendingWipe.cancelConfirmMigration: The terminal will return to the venue it was at before that migration, and you can continue with this one.
pendingWipe.cancelConfirmManual: The pending reset is dropped before it reaches the terminal. Nothing else changes.
pendingWipe.step1: Power the terminal on with internet.
pendingWipe.step2: Wait for it to restart on its own (1-2 minutes).
pendingWipe.step3: Verify again: this notice disappears as soon as it reconnects.
pendingWipe.discardableHelp: It has gone more than 24 hours without reacting. If the terminal is not going to execute that reset anymore, you can discard it and migrate it again.
pendingWipe.discardConfirmBody: The reset order the terminal never executed is closed and you can start this migration. If the terminal shows up later, the new migration will reset it anyway.
pendingWipe.discardConfirmMigration: The reset order the terminal never executed is closed and the terminal returns to the venue it was at before that migration — so it can't end up charging through one venue's merchant while sales are booked under another. Then you can start this migration.
pendingWipe.discardableFrom: You will be able to discard it from {{date}} if the terminal is still missing.
